cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 1700 python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, sys, json, subprocess, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline
random.seed(2024)
reqs=[]
# heavy compiles
for k in range(4):
    n=2048
    seen=set(); fib=[]
    while len(fib)<n:
        a=random.getrandbits(128)
        if a in seen: continue
        seen.add(a); fib.append({'prefix':pipeline.canonical_addr(a)+'/128','hop':random.randrange(65536)})
    reqs.append({'op':'compile','fib':fib,'capacities':[10**9]*8,'max_stride':32})
# lookups on the produced images
imgs=[]
for r in reqs[:2]:
    img=pipeline.do_compile(r); imgs.append(img)
addrs=[pipeline.canonical_addr(random.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
for img in imgs:
    reqs.append({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs})
# small random requests
for k in range(180):
    if k%3==0:
        n=random.randrange(0,20)
        seen=set(); fib=[]
        for _ in range(n):
            l=random.choice([0,8,16,32,64,128]); a=pipeline.trunc(random.getrandbits(128),l)
            if (a,l) in seen: continue
            seen.add((a,l)); fib.append({'prefix':pipeline.canonical_prefix(a,l),'hop':random.randrange(65536)})
        reqs.append({'op':'compile','fib':fib,'capacities':[random.choice([512,4096,10**9]) for _ in range(random.randrange(4,17))],'max_stride':random.randrange(1,33)})
    elif k%3==1:
        img=random.choice(imgs)
        reqs.append({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':[pipeline.canonical_addr(random.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(50)]})
    else:
        reqs.append({'op':'lookup','image':{'status':'ok'},'addresses':[]})
data=''.join(json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':'))+'\n' for r in reqs)
print('total input bytes', len(data))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=600)
el=time.time()-t
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print('elapsed %.1f s, responses %d (expected %d), rc=%d' % (el, len(lines), len(reqs), p.returncode))
print('stderr:', p.stderr[:300])
ok=sum(1 for l in lines if json.loads(l).get('status')=='ok')
print('ok responses:', ok)
EOF
